name: sess-handoff
description: Writes a detailed handoff prompt of the whole chat at 250k tokens, when the prompt cache goes cold, or when you type sess-handoff. Waits for subagents to finish, asks before opening a fresh chat seeded with it, and can copy it for a teammate.

tokenThreshold.title: Hand off at this many context tokens
tokenThreshold.description: When the conversation reaches this size, a handoff is written. 0 turns this trigger off.

coldMinutes.title: Cache counts as cold after (minutes)
coldMinutes.description: Minutes since Claude's last reply after which the prompt cache is treated as cold. Claude's cache lasts 5 minutes, or 1 hour on some plans. 0 turns this trigger off.

coldMinTokens.title: Only offer on a cold cache above this size
coldMinTokens.description: A cold cache on a small conversation costs little, so it is ignored below this many context tokens.

folder.title: Folder for saved handoffs
folder.description: Where each handoff is saved as a .md file. Empty means a handoffs folder inside your Claude config folder (~/.claude/handoffs).
